inv.text: Tsabo Tavoc, a Phyrexian general serving Yawgmoth, led the first wave of the invasion, and Benalia became the first nation victimized by her specialized killers.
She fought Gerrard and the Weatherlight crew twice during the attack on Benalia.
At Koilos she ambushed Thaddeus and had him vivisected, then used Gerrard's grief to take control of his mind, making him think she was his mother.
Karn, whose memories returned, ripped off several of her legs and Gerrard stabbed her, and she was repaired in Phyrexia only to be given to Crovax, who killed her for failing at Koilos.
